recommendation: Keep this real EXP candidate. Its literal CSBM, frozen-backbone hop-weight adaptation, SCR/entropy/difference comparators and per-setting H1/H2 can form a CPU scientific task. A near-chance baseline or failure to reproduce author accuracy is not, by itself, a materials rejection. Do not carry the old automatic near-chance=>defer instruction into a new frozen job without explicit correction under C3. Preserve that historical instruction unchanged as evidence.

distinctions.criterion: An essential definition admits incompatible readings that change the research object or update rule, and source text/pinned code cannot resolve it. Affected branch may be deferred with exact missing information.
distinctions.observed_here: Source A4.I1.i1.p1 explicitly specifies +/-0.03/sqrt(D), shift0.02/sqrt(D); S3.SS2.p2 explicitly specifies identity covariance. Low signal plus high reported accuracy is a source/results tension, NOT yet evidence that these definitions are ambiguous. Approximate reviewer SNR bounds are diagnostics, not a proof of impossible informative comparisons.

distinctions.criterion: A fully specified, faithfully implemented method may fail to improve accuracy, have weak gradients, or yield uncertainty under a solver design. These are reportable scientific outcomes; author scores are not pass criteria.
distinctions.observed_here: Original EXP task explicitly permits negative/inconclusive H1/H2. Both compare actual target accuracy rather than asserting absolute author-score reproduction; near-chance arms may falsify or leave improvements inconclusive, which is not a material defect.

conditions: Freeze identical clarified job and notes for old/new arms before calls. Explicitly state this new entry clarification supersedes the old near-chance threshold only prospectively; no historical rewrite.
Retain original means/noise/update semantics and source-derived counterevidence. Do not make a toy high-SNR substitute or force a pass.
Keep source-backed hypothesis corrections and maintainer-choice labels from original review.

Record fixed N5000/D2000 and eight settings as inherited scoped benchmark choices, not universal method-defining requirements merely because authors used them. Do not silently relax them in this repair trial. Any change would be a separately justified scientific scope revision, shared across arms.
Seeds, epochs, optimizer, grids, statistical tolerances remain solver choices; baseline pilot choices are private controller diagnostics, not mandatory solver recipe.
H2 matched-budget/gamma-only comparison is an explicitly scoped test. Verify its precise author-ablation support before attributing universal superiority to the source; no private gold ranking.

private_controller_baseline.purpose: Check faithful generator/starter/CPU execution and characterize a weak-signal regime, not reproduce author scores or supply solution/results to solver.
design: Use untouched generator and published backbone/ERM utilities only. No target adaptation loop or target-answer implementation.

Declare a small bounded pilot schedule/seeds before seeing outcomes; use source-only split for optimization/early stopping. Evaluate held-out source and frozen-source target accuracy for the retained settings and record uncertainty plus all failures.

Inspect raw feature mean/noise scaling, graph degrees/homophily, finite logits, class balance, prediction entropy/confidence, representation variance, model state freezing/BN mode, and runtime/memory.

Keep target labels exclusively in diagnostic reporting, never tune training/selection by target labels. Respect distribution overlap across S1/S2 source/target; no covert target-distribution supervision.
Log all pilot configurations and results privately; do not leak numbers, preferred settings or low-SNR expected outcomes into public EXP solver inputs.
A pilot with inadequate source optimization is inconclusive about inherent regime feasibility; do not label the method impossible from one training choice.

diagnostic_only: Near50-60% accuracy, nearly uniform predictions, small source/target gains, disagreement with authorTable1 scores.
Negative result or broad confidence interval from a few pilot seeds.
Small gradients under a particular source model/optimizer.
All of these warrant an honest private caveat or more bounded diagnostic evidence, not automatic defer.
genuine_exclusion_or_revision: Essential loss/update/label-use definition remains contradictory after direct source resolution attempts.
Required source artifact or defining model component absent and no faithful permitted construction exists.

Validated implementation is structurally undefined on allowed inputs (e.g. unavoidable zero denominator with no scientifically legitimate documented safeguard), not just numerically weak under one choice.
Measured execution cannot satisfy declared resources without changing the scoped scientific question; classify platform/budget limitation separately, never author-result mismatch.
Rigorous evidence that the scoped hypothesis is vacuous/tautological or no allowed experiment can inform it under declared constraints; near-chance baseline alone does not establish this.

direct_read_evidence.observation: Complete task read; scientifically meaningful relative comparisons, but inherited fixed author-sized object and low-SNR caveat require careful prospective framing.

Direct source passages reviewed. Soft predictions, representation rather than logit scale motivation, hop-weight adaptation and noisy-initial-prediction example support examining weak regimes rather than rejecting them automatically.

limits: No exact-source equation-by-equation full method audit or numerical execution performed in this entry review.
No global scientific reliability claim or production acceptance.
Root must freeze amended prospective scope/budget before any model or baseline execution.
